RY-L05-S01-A01.title: Arcana
RY-L05-S01-A01.description: Entering the state associated with a chosen Arcana.
RY-L05-S01-A01.effect: Intended to work with the Arcana's quality as a state of consciousness.

RY-L05-S01-A02.title: Angels of the Arcana
RY-L05-S01-A02.description: Working with the symbolic consciousness of an Arcana.
RY-L05-S01-A02.effect: Intended to obtain additional information about the Arcana's symbolic space.

RY-L05-S01-A03.title: Glyphs of the Arcana
RY-L05-S01-A03.description: Isolating individual symbolic elements of an Arcana.
RY-L05-S01-A03.effect: Intended to select an aspect of a situation more precisely and focus the work.

RY-L05-S01-A04.title: Arcana on the Chakras
RY-L05-S01-A04.description: Directing the symbolic energy of an Arcana toward a selected chakra.
RY-L05-S01-A04.effect: Intended to make the practice more manageable through the Fireball framework.

RY-L05-S02-A01.title: Fire
RY-L05-S02-A01.description: Working with the element associated with the present, energy and vision.
RY-L05-S02-A01.effect: Intended to diagnose, strengthen or direct the symbolic Fire quality.

RY-L05-S02-A02.title: Earth
RY-L05-S02-A02.description: Working with information, structures and the material level.
RY-L05-S02-A02.effect: Intended to support awareness of finances, artifact work and accumulation.

RY-L05-S02-A03.title: Water
RY-L05-S02-A03.description: Working with the past, ancient laws and traditions.
RY-L05-S02-A03.effect: Intended to explore causes, one's relationship with the past and alternative probabilities.

RY-L05-S02-A04.title: Air
RY-L05-S02-A04.description: Working with the future, alternatives and events.
RY-L05-S02-A04.effect: Intended to choose a probability and direct attention toward a preferred option.

RY-L05-S03-A01.title: Sephiroth
RY-L05-S03-A01.description: Receiving the quality and mode of activity associated with a Sephirah.
RY-L05-S03-A01.effect: Intended to build primary energy and a more harmonious state.

RY-L05-S03-A02.title: Archangels of the Sephiroth
RY-L05-S03-A02.description: More detailed work with the qualities and teachings associated with a Sephirah.
RY-L05-S03-A02.effect: Intended to support gentler and more precise work with people.

RY-L05-S03-A03.title: Orders
RY-L05-S03-A03.description: Addressing a symbolic angelic order for teaching, protection or practical help.
RY-L05-S03-A03.effect: Intended to provide support and direction.

RY-L05-S04-A01.title: Page
RY-L05-S04-A01.effect: Intended to work with the emergence of a quality.

RY-L05-S04-A02.title: Knight / Prince
RY-L05-S04-A02.description: The prince of the element and its more material expression.
RY-L05-S04-A02.effect: Intended to bring an elemental quality into practical action.

RY-L05-S04-A03.title: Queen
RY-L05-S04-A03.effect: Intended to support understanding and processing of information.

RY-L05-S04-A04.title: King
RY-L05-S04-A04.effect: Intended to manage a selected direction of work.

RY-L05-S05-A01.title: Tarot Cards
RY-L05-S05-A01.description: Working with the application and meanings of Tarot cards.
RY-L05-S05-A01.effect: Intended to explore the development of a situation and the person's question.

RY-L05-S05-A02.title: Divination Practice
RY-L05-S05-A02.description: Developing intuition through reading a situation.
RY-L05-S05-A02.effect: Intended to identify a problem and possible forms of support.
